records.title: Magenta Book Annex A analytical methods for use within an evaluation
records.date_note: Current page inspected; precise revision date not independently extracted in this challenge.
records.locator: A5.1 Interviews and focus groups; A5.2 Case studies; HTML lines 948–982 in retrieved page
records.supported_point: Purposive case studies explain contextual complexity using multiple sources; generalisation is constrained and interview willingness can vary.
records.limitations: Guidance is adapted to the current commissioned study; does not certify the design or justify a particular sample size. Do not claim formal process tracing, QCA or causal estimation.

records.title: The Futures Toolkit
records.date_note: Publication landing page identifies the updated 2024 version, last updated 29 August 2024.
records.locator: What is Futures Thinking; Including diverse perspectives; Scenarios The Approach; Policy Stress-testing
records.supported_point: Alternative futures and stress-testing are distinct from predictions; affected perspectives matter.
records.use: A bounded conditional outlook, without unsupported probabilities
records.limitations: Formal scenario guidance generally uses a much longer horizon. JGA is not conducting the toolkit's full foresight process or workshops.

records.title: Handling unpaid wages
records.locator: Keeping workers informed and Repaying workers; retrieved lines 17–55
records.supported_point: Delay or payroll mistakes can require communication and correction, with financial difficulty and bank fees relevant consequences.
records.limitations: Not a payroll error prevalence study, quantified retention model or ROI estimate. Do not turn advice into a numerical risk claim.
